instance_description:
Setting: A 12th-floor owner-occupied condominium in Minneapolis, Minnesota, used year-round in 2026, with balcony planters, assigned garage parking, storage cage, shared package room, and condo-association building systems.
Scope: Recurring activities include in-unit appliance upkeep, HVAC filter routines, water-leak prevention, balcony weather preparation, supply restocking, cleaning schedules, package and delivery coordination, access/security, and building staff or vendor communications.
Resources: Reusable records include resident profile structure, household contacts, condo activity logs, and blank text files for manuals, incoming building notes, and message drafts.
Exclusions: No caregiving, investment planning, mortgage strategy, association politics, insurance-claim strategy, major renovations, or native app state mirrored inside the database.
personal_description:
Identity: Linnea Thistle Park is a 46-year-old freelance cartographer who owns and lives alone in the Minneapolis condominium throughout 2026.
Responsibilities: She keeps the unit orderly and functional by organizing routine maintenance, supplies, cleaning, deliveries, balcony care, access permissions, building notices, utility issues, and service-provider scheduling.
Authority: She may approve routine in-unit household tasks, document conditions, coordinate with building management, vendors, neighbors, and delivery contacts, and manage guest or technician access within condo rules.
Restrictions: She cannot authorize common-area repairs, alter building systems, manage another person’s care, make primarily financial decisions, or share keys, fobs, or codes without explicit authorization.
